03 / METHOD

What the benchmark actually does

01

Generate

Draw speed, obstacle distance, road friction, and reaction time using a fixed random seed. A stopping-distance equation labels each scenario.

02

Train

Fit a logistic regression model on 3,000 scenarios. Compare it with a baseline that assumes a dry road and one-second reaction time.

03

Stress-test

Evaluate on unseen scenarios, then shift toward lower friction and longer reaction. Count false negatives: hazards the model calls safe.

Scope: Synthetic one-dimensional braking only. It omits perception, steering, traffic, real sensor error, and safety certification. The trained model approximates a known physics rule; using the rule directly is preferable in a real system.
